exposure: gonadotropin-releasing hormone agonist (GnRH-a) pretreatment before programmed cycles for endometrial preparation
programmed cycles for endometrial preparation without GnRH-a pretreatment
cohort: A cohort of 1934 women with polycystic ovarian syndrome (PCOS) undergoing 2733 frozen-thawed embryo transfer (FET) cycles at Tongji Hospital between January 2016 and September 2022.
finding: GnRH-a pretreatment before programmed cycles did not significantly affect pregnancy or perinatal outcomes for the general PCOS population in FET cycles, but it was associated with increased adjusted live birth and clinical pregnancy rates and lower miscarriage rates in a subgroup of patients who underwent both protocols, particularly in their second transfer cycle.
mod_finding: No significant difference was found in singleton perinatal outcomes in terms of delivery mode between the two treatment groups.
